premise: Inside a biomechanical lung orbiting a gas giant, breathable air is a traded commodity where exhalation tides physically shift institutional access.

exploration_focus: Dynamic room connectivity based on respiratory cycles and pressure differentials.
conflict_tone: High-stakes diplomatic tension and systemic environmental pressure.
visual_style: Top-down pixel art; teal membranes, ivory ceramics, saffron threads, charcoal shadows.

visual_consistency_rules: 1px charcoal outlines for all character sprites.
Breathing apparatus must be visible on every character.
Saffron threads must appear as 1-pixel wide highlight lines.
Strict top-down view; no side-profile features visible.

visual_canon.world_prompt_prefix: top-down pixel art, biopunk orbital lung interior, teal membranes, ivory ceramic hardware, saffron threads, grid-aligned, 16-bit aesthetic
visual_canon.sprite_prompt_prefix: top-down character sprite, biopunk respiratory suit, pixel art, strict vertical view, high contrast lighting
